title: MMRNet: Ensemble deep learning models for predicting mismatch repair deficiency in endometrial cancer from histopathological images.
summary: MMRNet uses an ensemble of image classifiers on H&E whole-slide images to predict mismatch-repair deficiency; four cohorts are used, including internal and external sets, with patient-level five-fold validation.
ai_technology: External cohorts and molecular/pathology labels provide reference validation; error analysis reports substantial false negatives/positives, so scope is classifier performance.
organization: State Key Laboratory of Oncology in South China
